deliberation: The schedule is contractible because it defines an exact duration, ordered predicates, artifact cutoffs, and fail-closed terminal states. Undefined terms, open allowlists, unknown classification, absent role matrices, or failed readback predicates remain false and block submission.
discharged_obligations: Reduced accelerated completion to explicit predicates and state transitions.
findings: Time expiry cannot change a predicate from unknown to true.
PT72H requires exact UTC endpoints in the opening record.
amendments: Validate deadline equals effective_at plus PT72H before any work is credited.
residual_uncertainty: A schedule-opening validator does not yet exist.
